name: House Bonisagus
description: True Lineage descended from Bonisagus and Trianoma, devoted to theoretical research and to peace and cooperation among the Houses; its domus magna is Durenmar.

name: House Guernicus
description: True Lineage that upholds and enforces the Code of Hermes as the Order's judges and investigators; its Quaesitores stand against the wheel of fate.

name: House Mercere
description: True Lineage that holds the magi of Mythic Europe together through communication, trade, and aid; its domus magna is Harco.

name: House Tremere
description: True Lineage that provides the strength of the Order, gathering influence and resources to respond to crises; it declared war on House Diedne in 1010.

name: House Diedne
description: Founding House whose founder contributed spontaneous magic to Magic Theory; it was Renounced during the Schism War.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House that followed House Tremere in declaring war on House Diedne during the Schism War.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House that followed House Tremere in declaring war on House Diedne during the Schism War.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House mentioned, like Flambeau, as interested in conquest or battle.

name: True Lineages
description: The four Hermetic Houses (Bonisagus, Guernicus, Mercere, Tremere) in which every magus was taught by a magus of the House, back to the founders.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The society of Hermetic magi founded in 767 by the Twelve Founders, conceived by Trianoma and built on Bonisagus's magic theory.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The laws of the Order of Hermes, upheld and enforced by House Guernicus.

name: Hermetic Oath
description: The oath sworn by Hermetic magi; Jovius was convicted of breaching it and magi Trianomae allegedly broke it by spying.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Hermetic rulings, including that a parens must spend a season a year teaching an apprentice.

name: Parma Magica
description: Magical protection invented by Bonisagus, offered by Trianoma to the Founders; the only Hermetic Breakthrough in canon, taught as an Arcane Ability.

name: Hermetic Magic Theory
description: Bonisagus's universal theory of magic, adopted by every House; Magi Bonisagi push its limits.

name: Puissant Magic Theory
description: Free General Minor Virtue that every magus Bonisagi possesses.

name: Puissant Intrigue
description: Free Virtue every magus Trianomae begins play with.

name: Intrigue
description: Social skill of scheming and political influence, detailed with Ease Factors for magi Trianomae.

name: Folk Ken
description: Social skill used to judge individual behavior; complementary to Intrigue and countered by Guile.

name: Guile
description: Social skill for deception, used to counter Folk Ken or resist Intrigue.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: Ability needed for copying texts, taught to Bonisagus apprentices and used to copy folios.

name: Teaching
description: Valuable Ability most magi Bonisagi have, taught during fosterage.

name: Latin
description: Language required to read and write books; improved during Bonisagus fosterage and used to decode Trianoma's Cipher.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Lore Ability; reading an item in a folio grants one experience point in it.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability used in crafty arguments over folio contents.

name: Leadership
description: Ability governing lab assistants and loud arguments.

name: Magic Lore
description: Lore Ability; a Magic Lore tractatus appears in the example folio.

name: Penetration
description: Arcane Ability for overcoming magic resistance; Glaucon has it.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue and Ability allowing sight of the invisible; Glaucon possesses it.

name: Figurine Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing construction of small wax or wood figurines of power; confers the Ability Figurine Magic 1.

name: Colens Arcanorum
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue making the character a member of the Colentes Arcanorum with rank cannophori.

name: Tenens Occultorum
description: Minor (Status/Hermetic) Virtue making the character one of the four Tenentes Occultorum, usually the Spring Tenens.

name: Linguist
description: Minor General Virtue increasing Study Totals for languages by a quarter; common among magi Trianomae.

name: Stockade Parma Magica
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: the character cannot suppress their Parma Magica, so friendly spells must penetrate it.

name: Seeker (Flaw)
description: Minor Personality Flaw: self-proclaimed membership of the Seekers, pursuing ancient magic and artifacts.

name: Fostered Apprentice
description: Minor Story Flaw: the character was fostered and owes favors to the fostering magus and a fellow apprentice.

name: Adept Laboratory Student
description: Common Virtue among magi Bonisagi; the parens never left the lab.

name: Affinity with Art
description: Common Virtue among magi Bonisagi, encouraged by the parens.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: Common Virtue for dabblers who change Range, Duration, and Target.

name: Hermetic Prestige
description: Common Virtue: the parens's reputation extended outside the House.

name: Inventive Genius
description: Common Virtue among magi Bonisagi.

name: Secondary Insight
description: Common Virtue: innate understanding of Hermetic connections between Arts.

name: Skilled Parens
description: Common Virtue among magi Bonisagi, who focus on teaching apprentices.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Common Flaw among magi Bonisagi; worsens the Gift's social penalty to -6.

name: Book Learner
description: Common among magi Bonisagi.

name: Deficient Technique
description: Common Flaw from a parens overspecializing in certain Arts.

name: Deficient Form
description: Common Flaw from a parens overspecializing in certain Arts.

name: Driven
description: Common Flaw: striving to be the expert in one's research field.

name: Apt Student
description: Common among magi Trianomae, who learn from people rather than books.

name: Deft Form
description: Common among magi Trianomae, giving greater control over an Art.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Allows easy interaction with mundanes; common among magi Trianomae and possessed by Glaucon.

name: Long-winded
description: Common among magi Trianomae due to constant travel.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Common among magi Trianomae.

name: Enemies
description: Story Flaw common among magi Trianomae; can be gained by botching an apprentice search.

name: Favors
description: Story Flaw arising from a parens's political meddling.

name: Weak Scholar
description: Flaw from time spent on the road reducing book learning.

name: Painful Magic
description: Flaw making spellcasting painful; Glaucon has it.

name: Disorientating Magic
description: Flaw possessed by Glaucon.

name: Infamous
description: Flaw possessed by Glaucon.

name: Palsied Hands
description: Flaw possessed by Glaucon.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue taken twice by Glaucon.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: Virtue granting a private vis source; Glaucon keeps his secret.

name: Strong-Willed
description: Virtue possessed by Glaucon.

name: Study Bonus
description: Virtue possessed by Glaucon.

name: Hermetic Magus
description: Social status Virtue of Hermetic magi, possessed by Glaucon.

name: The Gift
description: Innate magical talent; Bonisagus's potent Gift unsettled his parents, and it imposes social penalties on Intrigue rolls.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal held every 33 years at Durenmar's Forum of Hermes, presided over by the Bonisagus Primus as Praeco.

name: Tribunal
description: Regional meetings of magi; the Colloquium Delectorum is held at a regular Tribunal.

name: Praeco
description: Presiding officer of a Tribunal, able to set the agenda and silence or eject magi; the Bonisagus Primus is Praeco of the Rhine and Grand Tribunals.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House; the Bonisagus Primus appoints his successor and selects the Inner Circles.

name: Domus Magna
description: The chief covenant of a Hermetic House.

name: Archmage
description: Title of distinction; customary but not required for the Bonisagus Primus.

name: Wizard's March
description: Order sanction against a magus; Bonisagus Marched his filius Jovius, and refusing to destroy banned research brings a March.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal conflict between magi; declared over apprentice-snatching and fought during the Schism War.

name: Gauntlet
description: Final test ending apprenticeship; Bonisagi use the Theoretical Interview, Trianomae a solo journey.

name: Theoretical Interview
description: The day-long verbal gauntlet on Magic Theory and the Arts required of magi Bonisagi apprentices.

name: Apprentice Snatching
description: House Bonisagus's right, granted at the First Tribunal, to take another magus's apprentice, with suggested restraints.

name: Fosterage
description: House Bonisagus practice where magi Bonisagi exchange apprentices to teach Abilities and assist in the lab.

name: Continuous Research
description: Optional rule granting Lab Total bonuses for uninterrupted seasons on a single project.

name: House Acclaim
description: Free Reputation for magi Bonisagi measuring research status and determining rank.

name: Boukoloi
description: First House Acclaim rank of magi Bonisagi ('cowherds').

name: Daduchos
description: Second rank of magi Bonisagi ('torch-bearers'), expected to attend the Grand Tribunal.

name: Cannophori
description: Third rank of magi Bonisagi ('reed-bearers'), eligible for the Colentes Arcanorum.

name: Dendrophori
description: Fourth rank of magi Bonisagi ('tree-bearers'), from which Primi are chosen.

name: Folio
description: Compilation of Lab Texts and tractatus assembled by the Colentes Arcanorum after each Colloquium and copied at Durenmar.

name: The Folio of 1123
description: Example of a folio title, folios being named by the year they were made.

name: Colloquium Delectorum
description: Seven-yearly conference of the Colentes Arcanorum and Tenentes Occultorum held at a regular Tribunal.

name: Colentes Arcanorum
description: Inner Circle of five magi Bonisagi ('Collectors of Secret Lore') who disseminate House research via folios and can remove the Primus.

name: Tenentes Occultorum
description: Inner Circle of four magi Trianomae ('Tenders of Secret Lore'), named for the seasons, who keep Hermetic secrets from mundanes.

name: Spring Tenens
description: Least experienced Tenens Occultorum, covering Britannia, Hibernia, Loch Leglean and Stonehenge.

name: Summer Tenens
description: Tenens Occultorum responsible for the Iberian, Provencal and Normandy Tribunals.

name: Autumn Tenens
description: Tenens Occultorum overseeing the Roman, Rhine and Greater Alps Tribunals.

name: Winter Tenens
description: Most senior Tenens Occultorum, covering Transylvania, Thebes, Levant and Novgorod.

name: Magi Bonisagi
description: The research branch of House Bonisagus, followers of Bonisagus.

name: Magi Trianomae
description: The political branch of House Bonisagus, followers of Trianoma.

name: Seekers
description: Informal group of magi of any House, founded by Lucian, seeking the Old Ones and ancient magic sites.

name: Traditionalist
description: Type of magus Bonisagi refining Magic Theory; usable as a Magic Theory specialization.

name: Dabbler
description: Type of magus Bonisagi playing with Range, Duration and Target; a Magic Theory specialization.

name: Harmonizer
description: Type of magus Bonisagi integrating other magic into Hermetic theory; a Magic Theory specialization.

name: Tabula Geographica Magica
description: The Gazetteer of Magic, a catalogue of magical sites and regiones kept at the Great Library of Durenmar in Trianoma's Cipher.

name: Trianoma's Cipher
description: Secret shorthand code of magi Trianomae derived from Trianoma's Lab Text abbreviations.

name: Original Research
description: Rules for experimenting to achieve Breakthroughs beyond existing Hermetic magic.

name: Breakthrough
description: Achievement of original research: Minor, Major, or Hermetic.

name: Minor Breakthrough
description: A Breakthrough immediately usable in Hermetic magic, e.g. a new Range or Duration.

name: Major Breakthrough
description: A Breakthrough pushing Magic Theory without breaking it, often a teachable Hermetic Virtue.

name: Hermetic Breakthrough
description: A new Arcane Ability or the breaking of a Lesser Limit; Parma Magica is the only one in canon.

name: Discovery
description: Extraordinary Results Chart result required for original research, which must then be stabilized.

name: Extraordinary Results Chart
description: Experimentation chart on which a Discovery must be rolled.

name: Arcane Experimentation
description: Laboratory experimentation rules used for original research.

name: Hermetic Integration
description: Full incorporation of a Breakthrough into Hermetic theory so no Virtue is needed.

name: Lesser Limits
description: Limits of Hermetic magic whose breaking constitutes a Hermetic Breakthrough.

name: Limit of Creation
description: Hermetic limit whose breaking would let magi create permanent items without vis.

name: Limit of Vis
description: Hermetic limit that magic cannot change the Art of raw vis; Tillitus tries to break it.

name: Life Boost
description: Example Hermetic Virtue produced by a Major Breakthrough.

name: Horizon
description: Example new spell Range invented by Tillitus as a Minor Breakthrough.

name: Lancea Magica
description: Magical attack developed by Cerularius that pierces Parma Magica; banned by the Colentes.

name: Warping
description: Warping Points accrued when stabilizing discoveries.

name: Wizard's Twilight
description: Risk when gaining 2+ Warping Points during stabilization.

name: Final Twilight
description: End of a magus's career into Twilight, as with Cerularius.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; sites in the Gazetteer can be vis sources.

name: Magic Aura
description: Supernatural aura of a place; Trianoma's death increased Durenmar's.

name: Regio
description: Magical regiones explored by magi Trianomae and listed in the Gazetteer.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Ritual prolonging life; developed by Bonisagus and Trianoma.

name: Certamen
description: Magical duel; Bonisagus assisted Tremere in inventing it.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Record of lab work; submitted to Colentes and compiled into folios.

name: Tractatus
description: Short Hermetic treatise submitted to the Colentes.

name: Summa
description: Comprehensive treatise, compared to folios.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's item; creating one earns House Acclaim.

name: Familiar
description: Magical bonded creature; binding one earns House Acclaim.

name: Lab Total
description: Laboratory score influenced by Continuous Research and risk modifier.

name: Risk Modifier
description: Experimentation modifier used on the Extraordinary Results Chart, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Schism War
description: The gravest threat to the Order, ending with the Renunciation of House Diedne after an emergency Grand Tribunal.

name: Renunciation of House Diedne
description: Emergency Grand Tribunal's decision to Renounce House Diedne.

name: The Sundering
description: Event in House Tremere's history which magi Trianomae are rumored to have caused.

name: First Tribunal
description: Meeting where Bonisagus announced Hermetic magic and the right to take apprentices was granted.

name: Twelve Founders
description: The twelve magi who swore to the Order of Hermes in 767.

name: Mystery Cults
description: Ancient cults that fascinated Bonisagus and supplied Bonisagi rank titles.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Lost Roman magical cult loyal to the emperor whose rituals Bonisagus found under the Aventine.

name: Cult of Dionysus
description: Lost Roman-era cult sought by Bonisagus and Iozheza.

name: Cult of Mithras
description: Lost Roman-era cult sought by Bonisagus and Iozheza.

name: Cult of Osiris
description: Egyptian wizards whose incubation rite made Iozheza disappear.

name: Cult of Diana
description: Lost cult of Ephesus with ecstatic mysteries.

name: Chaldeans
description: Ancient people whose secret lore was in Bonisagus's library.

name: Lombards
description: Germanic tribe governing Florence.

name: Old Ones
description: Primordial beings who posed as ancient gods; sought by the Seekers.

name: The Dragon of the Hesperides
description: Dragon sleeping in a temple of the Hesperides who directed Trianoma and Viea to Bonisagus.

name: Amazons
description: Fabled women of Amazonia, possibly ruled by sorceresses.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of House Mercere who carry notes and folios.

name: Quaesitor
description: Investigator-judge of House Guernicus.

name: Bonisagus Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor attached to House Bonisagus who decides on banned research.

name: Hoplite
description: Enforcer allied to Quaesitores.

name: Custos
description: Guernicus companion role.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard.

name: Parens
description: Master of an apprentice.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of the Order, born in Florence in 690, inventor of the Parma Magica and Hermetic magic theory.

name: Trianoma
description: Thessalian sorceress who conceived the Order of Hermes and Founder of House Bonisagus; died 832 at the Grand Tribunal.

name: Viea
description: Trianoma's twin, who fled with Bonisagus's books and became an enemy of the Order.

name: Lucian
description: Trianoma's first apprentice and the first Seeker.

name: Notatus
description: First Primus of House Bonisagus, inventor of Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Thamus Collis
description: Bonisagus Primus during the Schism War who abdicated.

name: Jovius
description: Last apprentice of Bonisagus, Marched by his parens.

name: Murion
description: Archmage and current Prima of House Bonisagus, schemer and conservative.

name: Iozheza
description: Conjurer who trained Bonisagus and vanished during an Osiris rite.

name: Polus
description: Ninth-century magus Trianomae whose diaries are at Durenmar.

name: Cerularius Bonisagi
description: Tenth-century magus of Normandy who developed Lancea Magica.

name: Glaucon Trianomae
description: Magus Trianomae and Seeker who searches mountains for Mercurian temples.

name: Tillitus Bonisagi
description: Magus Bonisagi of Semita Errabunda attempting to break the Limit of Vis.

name: Moratamis
description: Quaesitor of House Guernicus at Semita Errabunda.

name: Guernicus
description: Founder of House Guernicus.

name: Fenicil
description: Figure of House Guernicus associated with Fenicil's Rituals.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere who promised his apprentices to Bonisagus.

name: Tremere
description: Founder of House Tremere, assisted by Bonisagus in inventing certamen.

name: Diedne
description: Founder of House Diedne and versatile spontaneous mage.

name: Damhan-Allaidh
description: Enemy who preferred beheading magi to negotiation.

name: Pope Gregory II
description: Pope of legend who may have passed Vatican texts to Bonisagus.

name: Circe
description: Legendary sorceress of Trianoma's maternal bloodline.

name: Medea
description: Legendary sorceress of Trianoma's maternal bloodline.

name: Moses
description: Figure whose magical writings were in Bonisagus's library.

name: Solomon
description: Figure whose magical writings were in Bonisagus's library.

name: Ra
description: Ancient Egyptian god Iozheza sought to meet.

name: Hermes
description: God whose shrine became Bonisagus's cave.

name: Massylian Priestess
description: Guardian of the temple of the Hesperides.

name: Durenmar
description: Domus magna of House Bonisagus in the Black Forest, built on a Mercurian temple.

name: Magvillus
description: Domus magna of House Guernicus.

name: Harco
description: Domus magna of House Mercere.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: Covenant of Tillitus and Moratamis.

name: Great Library of Durenmar
description: Library in the Tower of Bonisagus.

name: Tower of Bonisagus
description: Durenmar tower housing the Great Library.

name: Tower of Notatus
description: Durenmar tower housing magi Bonisagi.

name: Tower of Trianoma
description: Durenmar tower housing magi Trianomae and Redcaps; haunted by Trianoma's ghost.

name: Forum of Hermes
description: Meeting place of Rhine and Grand Tribunals at Durenmar.

name: Black Forest
description: Forest in the Holy Roman Empire where Durenmar lies.

name: Holy Roman Empire
description: Realm containing the Black Forest.

name: Florence
description: Bonisagus's birthplace.

name: Or San Michele
description: Florentine church where Bonisagus's uncle served.

name: Rome
description: City where Bonisagus lived on the Aventine Hill.

name: Aventine Hill
description: Hill in Rome where Bonisagus found the Mercurian well.

name: Ephesus
description: City of the Cult of Diana; overrun in 717.

name: Egypt
description: Where the Cult of Osiris was found.

name: Persia
description: Region Bonisagus searched for tomes.

name: Aegean
description: Basin Bonisagus roamed.

name: Cappadocia
description: Home of wizards whose memoirs Bonisagus had.

name: Southern Alps
description: Location of Bonisagus's cave shrine to Hermes.

name: Bonisagus's Cave
description: Former shrine to Hermes in the Southern Alps where Bonisagus developed his theory and Parma Magica.

name: Thessaly
description: Birthplace of Trianoma, famous for witches.

name: Ethiopia
description: Beyond which Trianoma traveled.

name: Temple of the Hesperides
description: Temple where the Dragon slept.

name: Vatican
description: Papal library of curious texts.

name: Greek Islands
description: Possible location of Bonisagus's lost books.

name: Amazonia
description: Fabled land of women.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting.

name: Mythic Cathay
description: Distant land to which emissaries went.

name: India
description: Distant land to which emissaries went.

name: Africa
description: Distant land to which emissaries went.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Provencal Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Tribunal of the Greater Alps
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal mentioned in House Bonisagus's organization.

description: Hermetic Art.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art.

description: Hermetic Art.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art.

name: Reveal the Lingering Spirit
description: New Intellego Mentem spell letting the caster see invisible ghosts.

name: Preternatural Growth and Shrinking
description: MuCo spell known by Glaucon.

name: Rise of the Feathery Body
description: ReCo spell known by Glaucon.

name: Palm of Flame
description: CrIg spell known by Glaucon.

name: Trust of Childlike Faith
description: ReMe spell known by Glaucon.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
description: PeMe spell known by Glaucon.

name: Pierce the Faerie Veil
description: InVi spell known by Glaucon.

name: Pierce the Magic Veil
description: InVi spell known by Glaucon.

name: The Invisible Eye Revealed
description: InVi spell known by Glaucon.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
description: Spell whose Lab Text is in the example folio.

name: Ball of Abysmal Flame
description: Spell whose Lab Text is in the example folio.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Spell whose Lab Text is in the example folio.

name: Wizard's Reach
description: Muto Vim spell Tillitus invents for each Form.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Ritual invented by Notatus, a Major Breakthrough from Parma Magica.

name: Arma Magica
description: Example discovery.

name: Parmulae
description: Example discovery.

name: Realm-Aligned Spells
description: Example discovery.

description: Portals of House Mercere.

name: Mutantum Magic
description: House Mercere magic.

description: House Tremere military units.

description: Place named in House Tremere's history section.
